name: Trailer Fetcher
author: Thunderhat
description: Downloads new trailers from TrailerAddict into a preroll bucket, tagged with TMDB genre/certificate, and removes them a week after release.

settingsSchema.label: Certificate region
settingsSchema.help: Used with the TMDb key on the API keys page to fetch genre, certificate and release date for each trailer.

settingsSchema.label: Download folder
settingsSchema.help: Absolute path (must be inside MEDIA_ROOTS) to save trailers into. Add this same folder as a bucket in Preroll Scheduler afterwards.
